note: v0, written zero-shot (no data, no training). Features: [rc_sym, dist, pi_i, pi_j, rank_out, rank_in, tw_slack, min_wait, demand_j, tw_width_j]. h0: j is among i's best successors by reduced cost (rank_out small). h1: i is among j's best predecessors (rank_in small). h2: absolute reduced cost is very negative. h3: forced waiting penalty (j opens long after i can leave even at its latest). h4: temporal tightness penalty (arc usable only if i is served very early). Output = weighted vote.
